fields.value: An Oasis in the Middle of an IT Hub with Worlds Finest Infrastructure & Facilities You can choose your home from a range of 2, 2.5 and 3-bedroom apartments, spread across 3 towers. Designed to create a statement by itself, S V PRIME, an oasis in the middle of an IT hub with world's finest infrastructure and facilities. True to its name appeals to you the moment you step in and gives a sense of getting uplifted into the heights of luxury and shining in its grand living. Its contemporary architecture and the bold facade offer abundance of green spaces. S V PRIME has an exquisite collection of xxxx high quality and spacious 1/2/2.5 & 3 BHK Apartments, offering supreme levels of comfort in a convenient location.The exemplary building offers a modern day of living perfectly blended into the urban design, space and elegance.
